mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(a.date, CURDATE()) AS date, COALESCE(a.user_id, 11) AS user_id, COALESCE(a.sales, 0) AS sales, COALESCE(a.cost_of_sales, 0) AS cost_of_sales, COALESCE(a.product_cost_auto, 0) AS product_cost_auto, COALESCE(a.product_cost_manual, 0) AS product_cost_manual, COALESCE(a.beginning_inventory, 0) AS beginning_inventory, COALESCE(a.ending_inventory, 0) AS ending_inventory, COALESCE(a.gross_profit, 0) AS gross_profit, COALESCE(a.sg_and_a, 0) AS sg_and_a, COALESCE(a.salary, 0) AS salary, COALESCE(a.transportation_cost, 0) AS transportation_cost, COALESCE(a.office_supplies_cost, 0) AS office_supplies_cost, COALESCE(a.rent_expense, 0) AS rent_expense, COALESCE(a.operating_income, 0) AS operating_income, COALESCE(a.non_operating_income, 0) AS non_operating_income, COALESCE(a.non_operating_expense, 0) AS non_operating_expense, COALESCE(a.pre_tax_income, 0) AS pre_tax_income, COALESCE(a.tax_expense, 0) AS tax_expense, COALESCE(a.net_income, 0) AS net_income, YEAR(CURDATE()) AS year, MONTH(CURDATE()) AS month, COALESCE(a.product_sales, 0) AS product_sales FROM (SELECT 1 AS id) AS dummy LEFT JOIN accounting a ON YEAR(a.date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(a.date) = MONTH(CURDATE())

SELECT sales_previous AS sales, cost_of_sales_previous AS cost_of_sales, product_cost_auto_previous AS product_cost_auto, product_cost_manual_previous AS product_cost_manual, beginning_inventory_previous AS beginning_inventory, ending_inventory_previous AS ending_inventory, gross_profit_previous AS gross_profit, sg_and_a_previous AS sg_and_a, salary_previous AS salary, transportation_cost_previous AS transportation_cost, office_supplies_cost_previous AS office_supplies_cost, rent_expense_previous AS rent_expense, operating_income_previous AS operating_income, non_operating_income_previous AS non_operating_income, non_operating_expense_previous AS non_operating_expense, pre_tax_income_previous AS pre_tax_income, tax_expense_previous AS tax_expense, net_income_previous AS net_income FROM accounting_with_revenue WHERE YEAR(date) = #{year} AND MONTH(date) = #{month};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accounting ( date, user_id, sales, cost_of_sales, product_cost_auto, product_cost_manual, beginning_inventory, ending_inventory, gross_profit, sg_and_a, salary, transportation_cost, office_supplies_cost, rent_expense, operating_income, non_operating_income, non_operating_expense, pre_tax_income, tax_expense, net_income, month, year, product_sales ) VALUES ( #{date}, #{userId}, #{sales}, #{costOfSales}, #{productCostAuto}, #{productCostManual}, #{beginningInventory}, #{endingInventory}, #{grossProfit}, #{sgAndA} , #{salary}, #{transportationCost}, #{officeSuppliesCost}, #{rentExpense}, #{operatingIncome}, #{nonOperatingIncome}, #{nonOperatingExpense}, #{preTaxIncome}, #{taxExpense}, #{netIncome}, #{month}, #{year}, #{productSales} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sales = VALUES(sales), cost_of_sales = VALUES(cost_of_sales), product_cost_auto = VALUES(product_cost_auto), product_cost_manual = VALUES(product_cost_manual), beginning_inventory = VALUES(beginning_inventory), ending_inventory = VALUES(ending_inventory), gross_profit = VALUES(gross_profit), sg_and_a = VALUES(sg_and_a), salary = VALUES(salary), transportation_cost = VALUES(transportation_cost), office_supplies_cost = VALUES(office_supplies_cost), rent_expense = VALUES(rent_expense), operating_income = VALUES(operating_income), non_operating_income = VALUES(non_operating_income), non_operating_expense = VALUES(non_operating_expense), pre_tax_income = VALUES(pre_tax_income), tax_expense = VALUES(tax_expense), net_income = VALUES(net_income), month = VALUES(month), year = VALUES(year), product_sales = VALUES(product_sales);
mapper.select: SELECT SUM(product_price * quantity) FROM orders WHERE YEAR(order_date) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(order_date) = MONTH(CURDATE());
